title: Questions 147-148 refer to the following notice.
passage_1:
Spring Reading Draw

To mark the start of the new season, Harborview Books is running a special monthlong event to encourage reading among our regular customers. We are pleased to announce our Spring Reading Draw.

Throughout April, whenever you attend an author talk or a book club session, you will receive one entry ticket. At the end of the month, we will draw one lucky winner to receive a brand-new e-reader.

To take part, simply collect your ticket from the host at the end of each session and post it in the box located in the lobby. You do not need to come to the store to win; we will contact the winner directly by telephone.
